description: A bidirectional import cycle links sandbox_executor.ledger and sandbox_executor.knowledge because ledger/rows.py deferred-imports CredentialRedactor from knowledge/records.py while knowledge modules import from ledger.
goal: Extract CredentialRedactor and its private credential-matching regex constants from apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/records.py into a new acyclic leaf module apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/credential_redactor.py (importing only stdlib and sandbox_executor.redaction, with zero imports from ledger or knowledge). Re-export CredentialRedactor (and any public symbols previously imported from knowledge.records) from apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/records.py for full backward compatibility, and update apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/ledger/rows.py to import CredentialRedactor from sandbox_executor.credential_redactor so sandbox_executor.ledger has zero imports from sandbox_executor.knowledge. Add an AST acyclic-import test and redaction parity tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ledger_knowledge_acyclic.py verifying zero imports from sandbox_executor.knowledge anywhere under sandbox_executor.ledger and preserving CredentialRedactor behavior in tests/test_knowledge.py and tests/test_ledger_secret_classes.py. Do NOT modify apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json, and keep every modified module strictly within its line budget. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Extracting CredentialRedactor into an acyclic leaf removes the ledger <-> knowledge circular import cleanly without breaking existing callers or overlapping open PRs.
acceptance_criteria: apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/credential_redactor.py holds CredentialRedactor as an acyclic leaf (zero imports from ledger or knowledge), apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/knowledge/records.py re-exports CredentialRedactor for backward compatibility, and apps/sandbox-executor/src/sandbox_executor/ledger/rows.py imports it from sandbox_executor.credential_redactor.

An automated AST import-layer test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_ledger_knowledge_acyclic.py verifies zero imports from sandbox_executor.knowledge anywhere under sandbox_executor.ledger and verifies CredentialRedactor redaction parity.

All changes remain within the 4 declared files (never modifying apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json), uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
